Strategy:

Threats:

* https://medium.com/mitre-attack/attack-v20-9701dd75ffb4 - ATT&CK v20 is out \o/
* https://cwe.mitre.org/news/archives/news2026.html#October05_CWE_5_0_Schema_8_0_Release_Date_28_October_2026 - changes to the way that @CWE_Program@mastodon.social manages weaknesses

* https://blog.report-uri.com/abandoned-analytics-domain-funnels-store-visitors-to-darksword-iphone-exploits/ - @ScottHelme reports on some interesting iOS malware lurking on long since expired domains
